title: Shiv Sena UBT crisis LIVE: Aaditya Thackeray hits out at 'cowardly' rebel MPs, says 'contest elections again'
description: Shiv Sena UBT crisis LIVE: Shiv Sena UBT chief Uddhav Thackeray and Aaditya Thackeray have accused the rebel MPs of betrayal and selling their loyalty after two MPs confirmed their switch to the Eknath Shinde-led Shiv Sena.
